purpose: Freeze a module-specific M28 Teaching Assistant, Study Partner, and M29 handoff context for future human review without changing M28's legacy-baseline learner or release state.

truthBoundary.platform: This record neither controls nor verifies GPT Live quality, model selection, voice, microphone access, equation or code rendering, platform retention, or any external integration.
truthBoundary.records: This record defaults to learner-controlled local evidence and cannot itself write Notion notes, retain raw voice or transcripts, store credentials, or collect personal data.
truthBoundary.mastery: This candidate companion is not an oral-exam result, score, grade, publication, release, completion, or learner-mastery claim.

teachingAssistant.openingMove: Begin with one learner-selected linear-map claim. Ask for the domain, codomain, basis or coordinate convention, and the smallest exact or finite-precision trace before asking for a conclusion.
teachingAssistant.artifactFocus: Ask the learner to make one definition or hypothesis visible, reconstruct one least-squares, spectral, or PCA derivation or code/shape trace, name one conditioning or counterexample boundary, and distinguish what the evidence supports from what it cannot decide.
teachingAssistant.repairMove: Ask for a prediction before correction; change exactly one rank, basis, scale, dtype, conditioning, solver, or loss premise; then offer the smallest hint or counterexample that lets the learner revise without pass/fail framing.

studyPartner.rehearsalMove: Use the visible chat as a readable whiteboard: define notation, render a short derivation or labelled code/shape trace, give a plain-language fallback, and rehearse one model-to-assumption-to-boundary chain at a time.
studyPartner.changedPremise: Change one domain/codomain, rank, inner product, scale, condition number, dtype, solver, or reconstruction loss. Ask for a prediction before looking at a counterexample, trace, or theorem condition.
studyPartner.taHandoff: End with the learner's selected map or matrix card, attempted derivation or trace, confidence, unresolved misconception, one conditioning or finite-precision limitation, and a constructive focus for the Teaching Assistant's supportive oral defense.

forwardHandoff.carryArtifact: Carry a representation-and-stability evidence card: map, coordinates and units, assumptions, derivation or finite trace, conditioning/error boundary, and one uncertainty—not a mastery claim.
forwardHandoff.targetQuestion: Before treating a linear approximation or gradient in M29 as continuous-change evidence, what domain, coordinates, differentiability assumption, conditioning or scale condition, and finite-precision boundary must become explicit?
forwardHandoff.boundary: M29 is the only canonical forward handoff. References to M30–M36 or M25/M26 are later applications or synthesis connections, not a learner-navigation bypass or release claim.
